# 🧠 opencode-proprioception **The agent's sense of its own context window — fill reports inside tool results.** [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@tuzelko/opencode-proprioception?style=flat-square&color=CB3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tuzelko/opencode-proprioception) [![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@tuzelko/opencode-proprioception?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tuzelko/opencode-proprioception) [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/TuzelKO/opencode-proprioception?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) [![OpenCode V2](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode-V2-5B8DEF?style=flat-square)](https://opencode.ai)
--- Context pressure is invisible until compaction arrives like a brick. **Proprioception** measures how full the window is on every request and leaves a small report inside completed tool results whenever the fill crosses a new step. Proprioception is the sense of where your own body is without looking. This plugin gives the agent the same sense about its own memory. ## 👀 What it looks like ```text [proprioception] context fill: 42% of the window (step 5pp, last crossing). ``` The line rides a tool result that was about to be written anyway, so it survives in history and costs no extra cache. ## 📦 Install ```sh opencode plugin add @tuzelko/opencode-proprioception ``` Or straight from Git: ```sh opencode plugin add github:TuzelKO/opencode-proprioception ``` Requires OpenCode V2. ## ⚙️ Configure `opencode plugin add` writes a plain string entry. To change the reporting granularity, replace it with the object form: ```jsonc { "plugins": [ { "package": "@tuzelko/opencode-proprioception", "options": { "step": 0.1 } } ] } ``` | Option | Type | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `step` | `number` | `0.05` | Reporting granularity as a fraction of the window. `0.05` = one report every 5 percentage points. Must be greater than `0` and at most `1`. | ## 🧠 How it works - `session.hook("context")` observes every assembling request. - The fill is the last completed message's token usage (input, output, reasoning, cache) divided by the model's declared context limit. - The report is appended to the next completed tool result when the bucket (`floor(percent / step / 100)`) changes. - Per-session state; failures are swallowed, the request always goes through. ## 📝 Notes - Silent when the selected model declares no context limit. - The percentage is approximate: it is derived from the last message's token usage and the declared window, not from a fresh tokenizer run. ## 📄 License MIT © Eugene Frost
